name: Khan Jehn's Head
summary: Khan Jehn's Head is proof that the Magram Khan has been slain. Uthek the Wise of Gelkis Village demands it as a sign of friendship with the Gelkis clan.

sections.title: A Sign of Friendship
sections.body: In Desolace, Uthek the Wise asks you to bring Khan Jehn's Head to Gelkis Village. Jehn leads the rival Magram centaur, and Uthek says the earth tells her their clan is growing weak. The Gelkis want their enemy's Khan dead, and they look to you to prove you stand with them.

sections.title: The Khan's Fall
sections.body: When you return with Khan Jehn's Head, Uthek calls Jehn strong but foolish. She believes earth magic is stronger than Jehn's might. With the Magram leader gone, Uthek expects the clan to fall, and says the Gelkis will rule Desolace.

faq.answer: Uthek the Wise of Gelkis Village asks you to bring Khan Jehn's Head as proof of friendship with the Gelkis.
Khan Jehn was the leader of the Magram centaur, the rivals of the Gelkis clan.

faq.q: Why do the Gelkis want Jehn dead?
faq.answer: Uthek says the Magram are growing weak and asks you to kill their Khan. She believes the Gelkis can rule once Jehn is gone.

faq.q: Where do I bring Khan Jehn's Head?
faq.answer: Bring Khan Jehn's Head to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village, in Desolace.

faq.q: What does Uthek say after Jehn falls?
faq.answer: Uthek calls Jehn strong but foolish and says the Magram will fall without their leader. He expects the Gelkis to rule.
